channel.title: MaheshKumarSE
channel.description: Practical notes on Intune, ConfigMgr, Windows 11, Cloud PC, AVD, Defender, Purview and Microsoft 365. What is new, what is broken, how to fix it and how to roll it out.

item.title: Windows 365 User settings are going away: what changes, when, and how to migrate before January 2027
item.author: noreply@maheshkumarse.com (Mahesh)
item.description: Microsoft is retiring Windows 365 User settings in Intune. Existing policies will not migrate on their own, and from January 2027 they stop applying, which takes local admin and point in time restore with them. A step by step guide to inventory, recreate and validate everything in the new Cloud PC settings.

item.title: October 2026 Patch Tuesday: the five CVEs I am patching first
item.author: noreply@maheshkumarse.com (Mahesh)
item.description: 1,411 CVEs landed in one month. These are the five that stood out on my vulnerability dashboard, why they matter on endpoints and servers, and the exact checks I use to confirm each one is closed.

item.title: Enterprise WiFi stopped connecting after the October update? Here is the cause and the Intune fix
item.author: noreply@maheshkumarse.com (Mahesh)
item.description: After KB5127648, WiFi, wired 802.1X and VPN connections that use PEAP with MSCHAPv2 stop signing in automatically on Windows 11. Why it happens, how to confirm it, and how to roll out Microsoft's temporary workaround with an Intune remediation.

item.title: Windows 11 October 2026 update: builds, fixes and what to patch first
item.author: noreply@maheshkumarse.com (Mahesh)
item.description: KB5127648 is a big one. A record number of CVEs, an exploited zero day, real fixes for AVD and VPN users, and the last update for 24H2 Home and Pro.

item.title: How to find and upgrade SharePoint .agent files before they stop working in March 2027
item.author: noreply@maheshkumarse.com (Mahesh)
item.description: SharePoint and OneDrive agents saved as .agent files stop responding after March 2027. This guide covers the inventory with the agent registry and the Agent Insights report, choosing a path for each agent, and doing the upgrade.

item.title: Office LTSC 2021 is out of support. How to replace it with Microsoft 365 Apps
item.author: noreply@maheshkumarse.com (Mahesh)
item.description: Office LTSC 2021 and Office 2021 stopped getting security updates on 13 October 2026. This guide covers finding the remaining installs, removing LTSC 2021 with the Office Deployment Tool, installing Microsoft 365 Apps and checking the result.

item.title: Remote Desktop fails with 0xC000000D when Administrator protection is on
item.author: noreply@maheshkumarse.com (Mahesh)
item.description: Standard users can no longer RDP into Windows 11 devices that have Administrator protection enabled. Here is who is affected, why it is spreading, and what to do until Microsoft fixes it.

item.title: How to onboard Linux desktops to Defender for Endpoint now the preview is open
item.author: noreply@maheshkumarse.com (Mahesh)
item.description: A full walk through for putting Ubuntu, Fedora and other Linux workstations into Defender for Endpoint during the public preview, from the onboarding package to a tested EDR alert.

item.title: Microsoft 365 Apps October 2026 security update: the builds to check for and how to get there
item.author: noreply@maheshkumarse.com (Mahesh)
item.description: The 13 October 2026 Office security release fixes 132 CVEs, including eight in Outlook. This lists the exact build for every channel and LTSC version, and shows how to push a device to it and confirm it.

item.title: How to move your Intune Windows security baseline to version 26H2 without a big bang
item.author: noreply@maheshkumarse.com (Mahesh)
item.description: The Windows 11 26H2 security baseline is in Intune, but existing profiles do not update themselves. A step by step way to create the new version, pilot it, swap assignments and retire the old profile safely.

item.title: Intune's new device page, bulk eSIM actions for Android and Teams calls on Managed Home Screen
item.author: noreply@maheshkumarse.com (Mahesh)
item.description: A round up of the smaller Intune changes from the September service release that make day to day device support easier, especially for Android Enterprise.

item.title: How to roll out apps and policies in rings with Intune deployments
item.author: noreply@maheshkumarse.com (Mahesh)
item.description: Intune can now release a Win32 app or a policy to one group at a time on a schedule. A step by step guide to deployment plans, plus the limits you need to know before you rely on it.

item.title: Intune stops using the EnterpriseEnrollment CNAME for Windows MDM only enrolment in January 2027
item.author: noreply@maheshkumarse.com (Mahesh)
item.description: From 15 January 2027 Windows devices enrolling with Enroll only in device management will no longer find Intune through DNS. Who is affected, what users will see and how to update your enrolment steps now.

item.title: Intune can now open Defender for Endpoint during Android setup on corporate devices
item.author: noreply@maheshkumarse.com (Mahesh)
item.description: A new connector toggle makes Defender for Endpoint open automatically during out of box setup on fully managed and work profile Android devices. What it needs, how to switch it on and the assignment detail that decides whether it works.

item.title: How to audit and block FTP and SFTP uploads with Endpoint DLP
item.author: noreply@maheshkumarse.com (Mahesh)
item.description: Endpoint DLP can now see and stop sensitive files leaving Windows devices over FTP and SFTP. This covers device readiness, the policy settings, evidence collection, testing in Activity explorer and moving from audit to block.

item.title: Endpoint DLP will report zip and rar files as one item from late October
item.author: noreply@maheshkumarse.com (Mahesh)
item.description: Endpoint DLP on Windows is changing how it classifies archives, so events will name the outer zip or rar file instead of each file inside. Here is what changes, when, and which reports and alerts to check before it lands.

item.title: Defender Antivirus platform 4.18.26090.9 renames a PowerShell property your scripts may read
item.author: noreply@maheshkumarse.com (Mahesh)
item.description: What changed in the 12 October 2026 Defender Antivirus platform and engine release, which scripts and reports can break, and how to stage the build through update channels and confirm it landed.

item.title: Copilot buttons are moving in Outlook, Word, Excel and PowerPoint. What to tell your users
item.author: noreply@maheshkumarse.com (Mahesh)
item.description: No licensing or admin changes, but users will find Copilot in new places. Here is what is changing, when, and the one admin setting to review.

item.title: ConfigMgr 2609 is here: what changed and how to upgrade safely
item.author: noreply@maheshkumarse.com (Mahesh)
item.description: 2609 is the first ConfigMgr release under the new once a year cadence. It drops some old platforms, fixes a comanagement problem and needs a bit of preparation before you click install.

item.title: ConfigMgr 2609 moves your CMG to new Azure VM sizes. How to check vCPU quota before you upgrade
item.author: noreply@maheshkumarse.com (Mahesh)
item.description: Updating to ConfigMgr 2609 migrates every cloud management gateway to Dadv6 virtual machines, and the migration fails with QuotaExceeded if the subscription has no room. How to work out what you need, raise the quota and confirm the CMG is healthy afterwards.

item.title: ConfigMgr 2609 now warns if you automatically approve all computers. How to change it safely
item.author: noreply@maheshkumarse.com (Mahesh)
item.description: The 2609 prerequisite check flags the Automatically approve all computers option, which Microsoft plans to remove. How to see which clients depend on it, switch to trusted domain approval and approve the stragglers.

item.title: Agent usage metrics in the Microsoft 365 admin center no longer need an Agent 365 licence
item.author: noreply@maheshkumarse.com (Mahesh)
item.description: From late November 2026 the active users, sessions, exceptions and run time figures for Microsoft built agents show in the admin center without Agent 365 or E7. Here is where the numbers appear, what they mean and how to read them without comparing the wrong reports.
